96: /// Acquires RLS-scoped connections from the underlying database.
97: #[async_trait]
98: pub trait DatabaseBackend: Send + Sync {
99:     /// Acquire a pooled connection with `ROLE`, `request.jwt.claims`, and
100:     /// `request.headers` set for the duration of the returned connection's
101:     /// transaction, so every subsequent statement runs under the caller's
102:     /// Postgres RLS context.
103:     ///
104:     /// # Transaction contract
105:     ///
106:     /// The returned connection holds an **open transaction** — the GUCs above
107:     /// are `SET LOCAL`, which requires one. A caller that executes anything
108:     /// with side effects MUST commit it before dropping the connection
109:     /// (`fdb_postgres::PgConn::commit`); otherwise the pool's recycle rolls the
110:     /// work back while the statement's own `RETURNING` clause still reports
111:     /// success, because it reads inside the transaction being discarded.
112:     /// Read-only callers may skip the commit.
113:     ///
114:     /// # Errors
115:     ///
116:     /// Returns [`BackendError::Connection`] when no pooled connection is
117:     /// available or the `SET LOCAL`/`set_config` GUC setup fails, and
118:     /// [`BackendError::Query`] when `rls.role` fails the safe-identifier
119:     /// check (fail-closed rather than interpolating an unvalidated role into
120:     /// `SET LOCAL ROLE`).
121:     async fn acquire(&self, rls: &RlsContext) -> Result<Conn, BackendError>;
122: 
123:     /// Run a single SQL statement under the full RLS context and return each
124:     /// result row JSON-encoded (`{"column": value, ...}`).
125:     ///
126:     /// `params` are JSON-encoded scalar bind values, one per `$N` placeholder
127:     /// — the same "send raw text, let Postgres resolve the target type"
128:     /// binding strategy `RestExecutor` uses for untyped filter values, not a
129:     /// typed bind. `sql` may be a plain `SELECT` or a DML statement with
130:     /// `RETURNING`; a DML statement with no `RETURNING` succeeds with zero
131:     /// rows.
132:     ///
133:     /// Consumed by Flint Kiln's `flint:host/db` and `flint:host/llm` host
134:     /// implementations to forward a WASM component's governed SQL call
135:     /// through the same connection/RLS-context machinery REST and GraphQL
136:     /// already use — see `fke-runtime`.
137:     async fn query_json(
138:         &self,
139:         rls: &RlsContext,
140:         sql: &str,
141:         params: &[String],
142:     ) -> Result<Vec<String>, BackendError>;
